bundle.shortDescription: Watch Twitch VODs as if live in your timezone
bundle.longDescription: Twitch Timeshift replays VODs on a simulated live schedule: pick your timezone and an offset, and VODs start at the same local time the stream originally aired. Join mid-VOD exactly as if you had opened the stream live.
